name: Hosea
lede: The twenty-eighth book of the Bible, in full: Hosea's wife and children and the names Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah and Lo-ammi, the valley of Achor for a door of hope, Jehovah's controversy with Israel — the cake not turned, the silly dove, they sow the wind and reap the whirlwind — and the promise: I will be as the dew unto Israel, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: A Door of Hope
books.blurb: The word of Jehovah to Hosea — go, take unto thee a wife; the children Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah and Lo-ammi; yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea; contend with your mother; I will hedge up thy way with thorns; the valley of Achor for a door of hope; I will betroth thee unto me for ever; and Hosea's own words: go again, love a woman, and Israel many days without king and without prince.

books.name: The Cake Not Turned
books.blurb: Jehovah's controversy with the land: my people are destroyed for lack of knowledge; a stubborn heifer; a snare at Mizpah and a net spread upon Tabor; come, and let us return unto Jehovah — your goodness is as a morning cloud; I desire goodness, and not sacrifice; an oven heated by the baker, and Ephraim a cake not turned; a silly dove; then the trumpet, the calf of Samaria, and they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind.

books.name: I Will Be as the Dew
books.blurb: Rejoice not, O Israel; grapes in the wilderness; their glory shall fly away like a bird; Israel is a luxuriant vine; sow to yourselves in righteousness, break up your fallow ground; when Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt — how shall I give thee up, Ephraim?; Jacob at Beth-el; O death, where are thy plagues?; and at the last: O Israel, return — I will be as the dew unto Israel; he shall blossom as the lily.
